# Style branches without costumes

Use this file when a named style or regional reference is an open direction. The style name is a
lead, not the brief, a quality verdict, or permission to replace an approved system. Record the
subject-grounded relation in existing `direction`, `layout` and `explorations`; `form-levers.md`
owns the controlled comparison. These branches add no dial values or package exemptions.

| Branch | Consequential distinction | Compare in real content | Reject the costume |
|---|---|---|---|
| Raw versus neo-brutalist | Exposed document structure differs from a deliberately graphic border/shadow system | Direct index/link relationships versus contained objects; keep action/focus/state legible and narrow borders from consuming content width | Roughness presented as a task failure exemption; thick outlines on every paragraph |
| Glass versus soft extrusion | Transparency explains a layer over content; paired shadows suggest a control in the surface | Worst changing backdrop, focus, selected/pressed/disabled states, and a solid reduced-transparency alternative | One attractive still hides low-contrast state; nested glass everywhere; a blur called a native material |
| Maximalist or retro | Abundance still needs a conductor; original archive and later revival are different evidence | One focal order, stable reading/action layer, repeated rhythm and controlled collision; localized text and static alternatives | A bundle of chrome, badges and pixel type called an era; a historical quotation mistaken for new product identity |
| Constructive modernism versus Swiss information | Geometry can encode construction/sequence; alignment and type can encode information order | Actual title/metadata/evidence/action alignments and reflow; each shape, size and serial label has a job | Primary shapes, tiny numbers or visible grids over an unchanged template; “International” treated as neutral or universal |
| Skeuomorphic versus flat | A familiar operation mapping differs from simulated surface texture; reduced texture still needs signifiers | Choose the least simulation that teaches the task, with exact values and non-gesture operation; test links, fields and selection without decorative depth | Obsolete object metaphor constrains the task; stitched texture supplies no mapping; flatness erases action/state cues |

A maintained platform system owns roles and behavior, not only an appearance. Call a bounded visual
influence an influence; do not imply compatibility, native integration, or dynamic palette behavior
from matching pixels. Keep the working product layer stable while a campaign or specialist control
owns a bounded expressive layer. Assign mixed influences different variables rather than competing
for the same hierarchy.

## Named local evidence, not national personality

Specify locale, audience, task, platform and operating context. A named company's pattern may be a
company rule, category convention, platform/policy obligation, language constraint or aesthetic
choice; separate these before transfer. A dense result list proves no national preference, and a
pale retail specimen does not define a country's design. Preserve receiving identity and use actual
local names, addresses, currencies, input methods and script metrics with fluent review.

Keep source, date/state/locale, observed relation, proposed transfer and stopping boundary together
in existing reference/claim records. Use only authorized evidence; this reference grants no browsing,
capture, automated search or proprietary asset reuse. Public company diagrams prove neither universal
pipelines nor bidirectional sync. Historical periods, fashion and audience response remain attributed
context or hypotheses, not universal causal laws or success predictions.
